rules.sentence: According to diagnostic criteria for dementia (DSM-IV, CID-10), other psychiatric disorders must be ruled out as the primary cause of cognitive or functional impairment prior to determining a diagnosis of dementia syndrome, a process which also applies to the diagnosis of the etiology of Alzheimer's and Vascular Diseases.
